name: Friends with Dogs
source:
Dogs, death, and the chase for what’s gone. Hayden is bitter and grieving, but he hides it well. College is his escape, yet distance brings no healing. He imagines leaving Earth itself, but the past still follows. Wherever he goes, they appear – like dogs.

[From [url=https://mr-thylacine.itch.io/friends-with-dogs]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
狗、死亡，以及对逝去之物的追寻。海登内心痛苦、悲伤，但他掩饰得很好。大学是他的逃避，但距离并不能带来治愈。他想象着离开地球本身，但过去仍然存在。无论他走到哪里，它们都会像狗一样出现。

[来自[url=https://mr-thylacine.itch.io/friends-with-dogs]Itch.io[/url]]
